Fianaise is an independent project that uses open data to look at Irish public life: who runs our schools, who owns the land, how safe our streets are to cycle, and how the law treats families. It isn't neutral. Each project starts from a question I think deserves more attention, and the writing says plainly what I think the evidence shows, including where policy falls short. What doesn't change is the method: every figure names its data source, and the data and code behind it are published, so you can check the numbers and draw your own conclusions.

*Fianaise* is Irish for evidence. You can reach me at [fianaise@proton.me](mailto:fianaise@proton.me).
